why_ai: Public works crews maintain physical infrastructure under statutory government authority that cannot be outsourced to AI.
why_clarity: Many workflows recur, but infrastructure knowledge lives in senior staff heads and subjective surveys.
why_digital: Roads, pipes and parks are worked on physically for residents who cannot choose another provider.

why_ai: Title II makes the government accountable, and facility surveys require physical measurement on site.
why_clarity: Self-evaluations and transition plans follow defined accessibility standards and checklists.
why_digital: Physical facilities surveyed on site, with plans and grievances handled as local paperwork.

why_ai: Officers inspect properties in person and exercise legal authority through citations, hearings and liens.
why_clarity: Each case follows a legally prescribed notice, inspection, citation and hearing timeline.
why_digital: Field inspections of local properties with paper notices and case folders.

why_ai: GASB standards bind every government because of the board's authority, not the drafting.
why_clarity: Due process is codified, but each standard is a consensus judgment tested only after adoption.
why_digital: Research, exposure drafts and comment letters are documentary, serving US governments only.

why_ai: Physical condition assessments and engineer-backed capital plans persist, though AI imagery speeds surveys.
why_clarity: Deterioration models are rarely tested against actual replacement outcomes.
why_digital: Pipes and pavement inspected in the field, delivered as plans through public procurement.

why_ai: Certified assessors must sign rolls and defend appeals, though AVMs automate most valuation.
why_clarity: Ratio studies objectively test assessed values against sales across every parcel.
why_digital: Parcel and sales data modelled on screens, with field reviews and public procurement.

why_ai: Registered municipal advisors owe issuers a fiduciary duty and are trusted for market judgment.
why_clarity: Bond structures follow known methods, but execution quality is rarely measured against comparables.
why_digital: Market data analysed on screens, advice delivered through meetings with regional issuers.

why_ai: Insurers put regulated capital behind every wrapped credit; their financial strength is the product.
why_clarity: Municipal defaults are rare, so underwriting accuracy is known only over decades.
why_digital: Financial disclosures underwritten on screens and policies sold into national bond markets.

why_ai: Markets and regulators rely on NRSRO ratings, so the agency's name is the product.
why_clarity: Published criteria guide ratings, but defaults that test them are rare and slow.
why_digital: Financial statements analysed on screens, ratings published electronically to national markets.

why_ai: The moat is extraction from public documents, exactly what LLMs now do directly.
why_clarity: Normalised fields extracted from audited statements are checkable against the source.
why_digital: Public filings in, normalised data series out, sold online.

why_ai: Member-funded advocacy and legislative relationships give the association standing AI cannot replicate.
why_clarity: Surveys recur annually, but legislative analysis and advocacy outcomes are contested.
why_digital: Surveys and analysis produced on screens for in-state member municipalities.

why_ai: The national operational record is hard to replicate, though in-product analytics are pure software.
why_clarity: Permit and work-order analytics compute defined metrics across thousands of jurisdictions.
why_digital: Operational records in, software reporting out, sold through public procurement.

why_ai: Staff mow fields, maintain pools and run camps for children in person.
why_clarity: Programmes recur seasonally, but park quality and programme value are loosely measured.
why_digital: Physical parks and in-person programmes for local residents, with online registration.

why_ai: LLMs draft specifications and evaluation criteria, leaving thin consultant judgment as protection.
why_clarity: Each procurement is shaped by jurisdiction rules and outcomes show after contract performance.
why_digital: Solicitation documents produced on screens with meetings for regional public clients.

why_ai: Credentialed actuaries sign statutory valuations and hold long relationships with pension boards.
why_clarity: Actuarial standards codify methods, but assumption accuracy is known only over decades.
why_digital: Member data valued on screens, presented to boards in meetings.

why_ai: A certified building official drives across the county to inspect construction under statutory authority.
why_clarity: Permit intake, fees and inspections follow clear decision trees and codes.
why_digital: Applicants drive in with paper forms; inspections happen on rural sites.

why_ai: Seasonal hiring, onboarding and scheduling follow rigid patterns that HR software automates.
why_clarity: The same positions, checks and certifications recur every season.
why_digital: Paper applications and timesheets digitise easily; applicants are local residents.

why_ai: A handful of workers plough snow, patch potholes and fix sewer backups by hand.
why_clarity: A repaired pothole or cleared road is visible, though tasks vary daily.
why_digital: Physical roads and drains maintained with a pickup truck for local residents.

why_ai: Statutory auditors sign findings and hold intervention authority over failing local governments.
why_clarity: Government auditing standards codify procedures applied to every local government each year.
why_digital: Financial records audited on screens; local governments cannot choose their state auditor.

why_ai: Payments, adjustments and delinquency workflows are rule-based processes ripe for full automation.
why_clarity: Bills are computed from reads and council rates, with exceptions handled by rule.
why_digital: Meter reads become bills and online payments for captive local households.

why_ai: Consultants defend rates in person at public hearings where residents contest every increase.
why_clarity: Cost-of-service methods are codified in industry manuals, though each utility differs.
why_digital: Financial models built on screens, defended at hearings for regional utilities.

why_ai: Licensed operators run physical treatment and pipe networks under Safe Drinking Water Act liability.
why_clarity: Water quality tests and regulatory limits give objective, recurring pass or fail.
why_digital: Physical pipes, valves and treatment plants serve captive local customers.
